scope.question: Trace the C5 high-frequency position repair and verify the actual WN18 GRU tracking/C5 runtime interfaces.

historical_c5_repair.summary: C4's all-axis coordinate change hurt HF position Q. C5's repair kept the C3 residual coordinates on X/Y and used requested coordinates on Z: M=diag(1,1,0). The DSSM14 encoder, shared 33x3 head, normalizer, delayed interval, PCF helper, and learning limits stayed fixed. This is the measured positional repair; it did not change the force-to-attitude yaw adapter.

references.supports: C4 HF regression; sole C3-to-C5 coordinate factor; unchanged helper/normalizer/limits; preregistered screen gates.
Independent raw replay, M110 definition, HF6 B/C3/C4/C5 Q, gates, and scope limitation.

position_path_is_active_not_options_only.supports: Loads the C5 position options and sets delayed prediction, M110, and the frozen method ID.
Runtime requires delayed prediction and exact M110, active FEATURE/X14/32 path, 1 kHz/100 Hz timing, gamma 12, beta 1.8 s, ±3 m/s² output, locked DSSM normalizer/head, and local delayed helper.
Actual feature assembly/inference, PCF event surface, completed j=n−10 target, acceleration-to-force injection, and M110 prediction reference using filtered a_f on X/Y and a_req on Z.
PCF reconstructs acceleration from the filtered full Euler triple and carries r_f=a_req−a_f in eta.

position_interface_checks.coordinate_and_units: PASS: position BS forms inertial commanded force in N and commanded acceleration in m/s²; stage1 outputs clipped acceleration and the runtime multiplies it by mass before injection.
position_interface_checks.filter_and_delay_timing: PASS: C5 runtime asserts dt=1 ms and 100 Hz events; delayed update uses the completed 10 ms j=n−10 interval; beta and event ordering match the locked helper.
position_interface_checks.actual_raw_path_check: Existing WN18 raw logs record M110, PCF enabled, and the exact mixed prediction-reference path; this audit did not rerun the Plant.

confirmed_yaw_interface_inconsistency.confidence: high for source/runtime inconsistency; low-to-moderate for any causal contribution to the HF task gap
confirmed_yaw_interface_inconsistency.finding: The force adapter documents its yaw argument as reference yaw but the active position path passes actual yaw x(k,9) to solve roll/pitch, then replaces the returned yaw with desired r.euler(3). The command filter and PCF consequently use [roll/pitch solved at actual yaw; desired yaw]. For nonzero yaw error, the unfiltered commanded force is not exactly closed by this mixed Euler target.

references.supports: Adapter contract says reference yaw; it solves roll/pitch from that yaw and applies tilt projection.
Active caller passes actual yaw, overwrites the output yaw with reference yaw, filters the mixed target, then sends the filtered full Euler state to PCF.
Position BS uses actual yaw for its own force-direction solve and reports commanded acceleration in m/s² after force residual subtraction.
The discrepancy is evaluated through filtered Euler realization and PCF residual state, so unfiltered closure error is not the final closed-loop error.

existing_raw_reconstruction.cohort: same six HF_W09_W14 scenes named by task_attitude_filter_wn12_hf_screen_v1/MANIFEST.json, mapped to the original WN18 GRU full72 raw via its parent MANIFEST.json
existing_raw_reconstruction.method: Read position_commanded_force_N, state yaw, and command_filter_target_euler. Reconstruct the adapter roll/pitch using actual yaw, then pair that RP with desired yaw; compare T/m*R([RP;yaw_des])*e3−g against commanded acceleration. Repeat with RP recomputed from the same commanded acceleration at desired yaw. Compute geodesic SO(3) angle between the two unfiltered targets.
existing_raw_reconstruction.impact_assessment: The interface is real, but its pooled target change is about 8.3% of the reported HF WN18-vs-B task gap and scene-RMS ranges from 0.034 to 0.606 mrad. This does not establish it as the main performance cause. PCF explicitly tracks a_req−a_f and C5 uses logged a_f on X/Y, which may absorb part of filtered-reference mismatch. A single desired-yaw-consistent variant would be a clean follow-up only if prioritized; no variant or Plant run was made here.

other_interfaces_reviewed.gru_normalizer_and_feature_order: PASS: active GRU feature is [Euler-angle error; body rates; nominal body moment; four arm commands] (13 values); inference normalizes with frozen 13-value input mean/std.
other_interfaces_reviewed.gru_output_units_and_beta: PASS: frozen output is three rad/s² residuals; per-axis dmax is [45,45,4.7124], beta rises over 2.2 s, then fixed controller J0 maps the clipped/scaled vector to N·m.
other_interfaces_reviewed.tracking_surface_and_update_sign: PASS: BS surface is alpha−EulerRate; online head uses T' times clipped surface and the negative beta*phi*(gamma.*drive)' update. No sign mismatch was found.

source_refs.supports: Active 13-feature GRU call, per-axis config inputs, online trace and causal output-before-update order.
Frozen normalization, rad/s² clipping and beta, fixed J0 torque conversion, surface map, and online update sign.
ZYX Euler/body-rate map and alpha−EulerRate surface.
Locked per-axis attitude limits/beta, WN18 filter, C5 position model/hash, tracking parameters.

decision.conclusion: C5's high-frequency positional repair is specifically the active M110 coordinate split plus unchanged delayed-PCF path. That path is wired into WN18 GRU runtime and raw logs. One separate yaw-contract inconsistency is confirmed in the force-to-attitude caller; magnitude is measurable but insufficient to label it the cause of the HF task regression. No C5 coordinate, filter timing, GRU normalizer, per-channel dmax/beta, units, or online tracking sign error was found in the reviewed active chain.
decision.next_small_experiment_if_requested: One isolated no-Plant assertion/fixture for force-to-attitude desired-yaw closure, followed only if useful by a one-factor HF screen using desired yaw consistently while holding GRU, C5 M110/PCF, WN18 filter, and all other parameters fixed.
